category_edits.rationale: Warm up linearly over epochs 1–10, then decay the learning rate with a cosine schedule to 10% of the baseline rate at epoch 200. This may stabilize early optimization and late ranking performance while preserving Adam, batch size, dropout, weight decay, loss, and checkpoint selection.

change_summary: Add 10-epoch linear learning-rate warmup followed by cosine decay to 0.1× LR at epoch 200; enforce the 200-epoch cap. Model architecture and predictor remain unchanged.
